author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಯಲಿ ಗೆದ್ದಸುಖ ಕೆಲಸಮಯ ಉಳಿಯುವುದು
ಭ್ರಾಂತಿಯನು ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸುತ ಗರ್ವ ಮೊಳೆಸುವುದು
ಶಾಂತಿಸಂಯಮವಿರಲು ವಿಕಸನವೆ ಶಾಶ್ವತವು
ಕಾಂತಿತುಂಬುವುದದುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The joy of winning by revolution lasts only a while;
it breeds illusion and makes pride sprout;
with peace and restraint, growth is lasting;
that is what fills life with radiance, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Victories won by upheaval are short-lived and breed pride and illusion. Growth rooted in peace and self-control lasts, and makes life radiant.
